description: Call when a call to a third-party service fails or behaves unexpectedly. Paste the error text. Returns up to 5 verified traps whose symptoms match it, closest first, each with cause and fix. Returns nothing when no trap matches closely. Use lookup_traps instead before writing code.

error_text.description: The error message or unexpected output, as shown. Known key and secret formats are redacted before matching.

include_stale.description: Also match traps not re-checked recently. Default false.

provider.description: Optional service slug or name to search within, e.g. "stripe". Omit to search every provider.

name: search_traps
title: Search traps by error text
